alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar Highway (NH44) shut for 3rd straight day; 1,000+ vehicles stranded
alerts.summary: Fresh landslides at Gangroo (Banihal, Ramban) and multiple points in Udhampur district have kept NH44 — the only all-weather road link to the Kashmir Valley — closed for a third consecutive day. Over 1,000 vehicles remain stranded across Ramban, Nagrota, Jammu, Udhampur, Lakhanpur and Samba. IMD forecasts continued rain through July 31, with peak activity July 29-30.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM stoppage: Valley-bound linehaul to Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag hubs remains cut off. Continue non-serviceable (NS) flags for Kashmir Valley pincodes, hold Jammu-side buffer stock, and route non-adherence to this root cause rather than partner performance until NHAI confirms reopening.

alerts.title: South India truckers reaffirm Aug 1 indefinite strike threat over VLTD mandate; govt deadline was Jul 30
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across six southern states have given the government until July 30 to withdraw the mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Device (VLTD)/panic-button rule and address toll and compliance costs, or face an indefinite strike from August 1. No resolution has been reported as of today.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P now: if the strike proceeds Aug 1, expect FM linehaul stoppages out of Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs. Pre-position 5-7 days buffer inventory, line up alternate LM partners, and draft SLA-relaxation comms for southern pincodes ahead of Aug 1.

alerts.title: Himachal Pradesh: 150+ roads shut by rain-triggered landslides and flash floods
alerts.summary: Torrential rain has closed over 150 roads across Himachal Pradesh — 57 in Mandi, 33 in Chamba, 31 in Kullu, 14 in Shimla — with an orange alert active in four districts. 68 water-supply schemes and 72 power transformers are also affected.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Mandi, Chamba, Kullu, Shimla pincodes: hold NS flags on cut-off talukas, expect multi-day TAT breaches for hill-town deliveries, and pre-clear non-adherence tickets tied to these districts rather than penalizing 3P partners.

alerts.title: Uttarakhand: Yamunotri Highway and 120 roads blocked; NH stretch washed away at Uttarkashi
alerts.summary: Heavy rain has blocked around 120 roads including 3 national highways. A landslide at Syanachatti (Uttarkashi) washed away nearly 100 metres of the Yamunotri Highway; around 100 stranded pilgrims were evacuated after a two-day cutoff.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Uttarkashi, Rudraprayag, upper hill pincodes: maintain NS flags and alternate routing via Dehradun-Rishikesh corridor; expect extended TAT for hill-district deliveries through early August.

alerts.title: Assam floods persist; Army & Air Force remain on evacuation standby
alerts.summary: Continued monsoon rainfall keeps several Assam districts under flood alert, with low-lying areas submerged and state authorities maintaining Army/Air Force standby for possible evacuations.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Northeast: keep NS flags on worst-hit Assam pincodes, monitor Guwahati hub inbound linehaul for delays, and coordinate contingency capacity with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate NE routing.

alerts.title: Konkan & Goa: orange alert rain hits NH66, Mumbai-Pune corridor; ghat sections risk boulder falls
alerts.summary: IMD orange alert for heavy rain is active over North/South Goa and Maharashtra's Sindhudurg and Ratnagiri districts. NH66 remains risk-prone for rockfalls in the Tamhini/Varandha ghats, while the Khopoli-Kusgaon corridor has seen boulder falls; Mumbai-Pune Expressway movement continues to slow.
alerts.impact: Watch list: build extra transit buffer for Pune/Navi Mumbai/Goa hub dispatches; keep alternate routing on standby for Karjat-Lonavala and NH66 ghat sections through August.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Delhi-Haridwar NH reserved for kanwariyas; heavy-vehicle ban from Jul 30, full ban Aug 4-12
alerts.summary: Delhi Police traffic advisory (effective Jul 29 - Aug 12) restricts heavy-vehicle movement on the Delhi-Haridwar NH and Ganga Canal road from July 30, with a full vehicle ban on stretches from Aug 4-12. Muzaffarnagar and other UP districts have separate diversion plans in place.
alerts.impact: LM/FM slowdown risk — Delhi NCR, western UP, Uttarakhand: reroute linehaul via EPE/Delhi-Dehradun Expressway/NH-9, build extra transit time for Meerut/Muzaffarnagar/Haridwar-linked hubs, and expect rider mobility slowdowns in NCR through Aug 12.

alerts.title: Delhi: student-led protests over exam-paper leaks keep central-Delhi mobile internet curbs in play
alerts.summary: Youth-led 'Chalo Sansad' protests demanding accountability over exam-paper leaks led authorities to impose mobile internet curbs around Jantar Mantar/central Delhi, since extended amid continuing unrest through the Monsoon Session.
alerts.impact: Localized watch only: minimal direct LM/FM impact expected, but monitor rider app connectivity and delivery OTP/tracking issues for NCR pincodes near protest zones; no NS flags needed unless curbs expand.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel steady at multi-city highs; LPG/CNG flat for over a month
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged since OMCs' May 25 hike but sit at elevated levels — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.21/₹99.82, Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Kolkata petrol above ₹110, Hyderabad diesel ₹103.82. Crude eased slightly last week on hopes of Strait of Hormuz shipping resuming.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: no immediate LM/FM disruption, but sustained high fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks.
